title: Agent-based simulation of clinician adoption
purpose: Models heterogeneous clinicians whose adoption changes through training, peer influence, perceived usefulness, workload, and adverse incidents.
input: `Agents` sheet with agent_id, role, initial adoption, trust, digital skill, peer influence, and workload; `Parameters` sheet with periods and effect strengths.
outputs: Agent-level adoption history, role summaries, adoption trajectory, heterogeneity distribution, and scenario interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
